About

We care about listening carefully and being honest with the people we work with. We want sessions to feel calm, respectful and focused on you.

About the clinician: Sample Name, Clinical Psychologist. Sample Name works collaboratively and at a pace that suits each person. Sessions focus on understanding what matters to you and building practical skills.

Therapy here is a working relationship. You know your own life best; our part is to listen, ask useful questions and help you find a way forward.

We start by understanding what brings you in and what you'd like to be different. From there, we agree on a focus together and review it as we go.

Individual Therapy

Individual therapy is one-to-one time to talk through what's on your mind and work on the changes you'd like to make.

It may suit people who want space to make sense of something difficult, or who would like support through a change in their life.

In our first session, we talk about what brings you in and what you'd like from therapy.

Session length*1 hour or 90 minutes

REGULATE

REGULATE is a group program based on DBT (dialectical behaviour therapy). It focuses on learning and practising DBT skills in a group setting.

Format*Weekly group sessions, in person

Length*10 weeks

Group size*Up to 10 people

Facilitator*Clinical psychologist

FAQs

Is this a crisis service?

This is not a crisis service. If you are in danger, call 000. Lifeline is 13 11 14.

What happens after I send an enquiry?

*We'll read your message and get back to you about next steps.

What should I include in my enquiry?

*Just which service you're asking about, a few words about what you're looking for, and how you'd like us to contact you. You don't need to include detailed health information.

Is my enquiry private?

*You can read how your information is handled in the privacy policy.

Can I ask about REGULATE before joining?

*Yes. Use the REGULATE enquiry form to ask any questions before you decide. Upcoming dates: 00/00/2027
